about: The order SweK peers take the rig's rounds (2026-11-23). One job per round, so free peers take different rounds at once; the priority IS the order (highest first). hours = rough cost on four workers. Reasons are the value of the answer per hour: cheap flights on stored networks first, then the redraws of the strongest earlier results, then the new prices, then the day-long searches, then the replication of H46.
